Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP pressure, Smart Kardia, low-MP Focus, DRK macro, warnings, assists, and clarity.
Description: A local PvP HUD integrating an optional held-key Smart Kardia helper, set-only low-MP Focus Target and exact DRK Shadowbringer macro helpers, a top-center 3+ enemy alarm with sound/Sprint options, isolation, pressure and CC-protection cues, resource auras, fail-closed assists, team communication and target highlights.
Changelog: Adds a separate default-off Smart Kardia held-key helper for PvP Sage in exact Crystalline Conflict. A complete, unique, stable exact five-player party view may select self or an exact living, targetable party member with trusted direct incoming pressure from at least two unique enemies; non-self candidates also require native 30-yalm range and line of sight. Higher pressure wins, then lower exact HP ratio and stable party/actor identity. If the highest-ranked candidate already has local-source Kardion, no attempt is made and no lower candidate is selected. The frozen actor, pressure, Kardion source, Kardia metadata/readiness, and native reachability are revalidated before one spent native request, with no selected-target mutation, alternate, fallback, replay, or retry. Configuration schema 25 keeps the option off for fresh, upgraded, and reset configurations; live dispatch and application still require current-patch confirmation.
